body:
# D1b wide-integer foundation candidate

D1a is human accepted and published at 93bf1e452cc4c57b9aaf412ae016e318c7be6ceb. First D1b foundation now passes automatic qualification; immutable bundle 94e72ff56649079472a59b33ae9ba1514b49dcb5c8c919ace369de6e46fb2c6a at /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-036/delivery/94e72ff566490794, pointer delivery.json and README.md alongside. This candidate remains uncommitted pending the Author's staged Oryx visual/keyboard review; not a release of the entire D1 numeric surface.

Supports uint32/sint32 packed globals/arrays (tags 7/8), checked +/- and all six comparisons, inclusive Bounds and checked numeric integer casts among 16/32-bit signed/unsigned types. Existing typed narrow intermediates do NOT widen implicitly: convert operands before forming a wide expression. Four-byte array count<=16383, indices remain 16-bit with explicit checked narrowing. Root-v1 and prior layouts unchanged; private cleanup/unload retain arrays/root. Wide multiplication/divmod/shifts/wide-float casts reject explicitly; they and full route/contact/projection replay remain subsequent reviewed GOLEM-036 steps. Existing agreed division status 6 is recorded but not implemented.

Host 3872 cases plus direct all 8 published add/sub and 29 in-source-domain conversion expected results pass; two input values outside source 32-bit domains are explicitly deferred. Max-array offset 65528 and widening-order tests pass. Stock 30 probes/ 60 motion calls pass; actual Xtensa JIT/interpreter default AND relocated each pass 2311 observations/23110 bytes. Both engines' 600-frame common-source visual passes 590 observations/5846 bytes and 56320 final playfield pixels/MOS return. Complete 122-file bundle and independent exported source rebuild/three package reproducibility checks pass.

Animation represents stations around 3.2million, signed Q8 lateral±38400 and a tick counter crossing 65535; no float substitution. Native text/data 3256/268, conservative module static-frame sum 192 excludes service/firmware callers; peak views 3. Existing SDK/firmware/admission policy unchanged. Ordinary calculate+draw+VSYNC frame remains 15 wire bytes, no per-marker host position updates. This is a numeric foundation demonstration, not game simulation/helper linking/scheduler qualification.

Your v0.3 helper contract has separately been accepted for D2 planning in contract-accepted-eight. No GOLEM-037 implementation released. Candidate materials are available for your owned adapter review; no integration execution requested before your applicable release gates.
